description: Places a perp order on the connected venue through Riv's governance layer: every order is evaluated against the organization's trading policies before any execution, and executed orders carry Riv's builder code. BLOCK and REQUIRE_APPROVAL are normal outcomes, not errors — read the Reason and ReasonCode and adapt (reduce size or leverage, switch asset, or wait for approval). ALLOW with Executed: yes means the venue accepted the order in this call. A venue rejection (HTTP 422) is ALSO a normal outcome, not an error: Execution: failed plus the venue's own reason (quoted, untrusted) — fix the order and submit a NEW intent with a NEW clientOrderId.

clientOrderId.description: Idempotency key for this order. When RETRYING the same order (timeout, unclear outcome), REUSE the exact same value — Riv will return the original outcome instead of placing a duplicate. A NEW order intent needs a NEW value. Auto-generated if omitted (the response/error echoes it for retries).

expiresAfterSeconds.description: Limit only. Cancel the resting order automatically if not filled within N seconds (server-enforced cap applies).

limitPrice.description: REQUIRED for limit orders (rejected on market): the exact price submitted to the venue. Prices the venue tick cannot represent are rejected (limit_price_precision) rather than silently altered.

notional.description: Order size in USDC notional (up to 2 decimals).

orderType.description: market executes immediately (IoC at an aggressive price); limit rests on the book at limitPrice until filled, canceled, or expired.

reduceOnly.description: Only reduce an existing position; exempts loss-halt policies.

tif.description: Limit only. gtc (default) rests until filled/canceled; alo is post-only (maker).
